news.title: The Badgers are back in town
news.summary_en: The UW–Madison campus looked a little more vibrant as students returned for the start of a multiday residence hall move-in.

news.title: New UW faculty get a warm Wisconsin Welcome
news.summary_en: At a picnic Wednesday at Olin House, new UW–Madison faculty members and their families got their own chance to connect.

news.title: Study linking environmental factors and Alzheimer’s disease awarded NIH funding
news.summary_en: The nationwide study led by the UW School of Medicine and Public Health explores the relationship between Alzheimer’s disease, environmental factors and lifetime experiences.

news.title: Human Ecology students help Harley-Davidson rev up the next generation of riders
news.summary_en: How can Harley-Davidson attract the next generation of brand loyalists? Five UW–Madison students collaborated with the iconic, Wisconsin-based company to share their ideas.

news.title: Chancellor search committee to hold Sept. 10 listening session
news.summary_en: The session will take place at Union South with a virtual participation option and is open to the public.

news.title: Welcome to ‘Reg Week’
news.summary_en: The UW Marching Band’s audition process is an intense but rewarding experience.

news.title: $27M WARF investment fuels UW–Madison’s next frontiers in research
news.summary_en: The gift aims to accelerate four high-impact research initiatives at the university: quantum technologies, brain health, fusion energy and national security.
